resources.string: Reads the CamAPS FX screen while you use it, to record Boost, Ease-off, bolus calculator carbs and active insulin, and sends them to your Nightscout. It only reads CamAPS FX. It never taps, types or changes anything in CamAPS or any other app.
Hear about each bolus FX Watcher records (units, carbs and time), if sharing is turned on in FX Watcher.
